fixture_source: Synthetic source generated by harness; no user document contents. Identical source, default rules, and syntax scanner for both parsers.

notes: Candidate excludes TeX delimiters/command syntax from prose tokens; total token counts therefore differ. Existing math reconstruction/source mapping tests still pass.
No parsing work runs on the UI thread. Argument delimiter lookup uses one prepass instead of rescanning nested suffixes; nesting is bounded at 128.
This is one local matched microbenchmark using shared debug dependency artifacts, not a cross-platform guarantee or a production end-to-end benchmark.
The temporary baseline source is identified by its digest; no obsolete parser copy is retained in the repository.
